headline: Penn State Behrend stays unbeaten with five wins
dek: Penn State Behrend has won all five of its matches without a draw or a loss, scoring 36 goals while conceding only three. No other program in the conference has gone through the season without a defeat.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Scoring across the conference drops off steeply past the top programs: Pitt-Greensburg's 50 goals exceed the combined totals of Hilbert, Mount Aloysius, Penn State Altoona, Pitt-Bradford, Carlow, and La Roche.

wire.line: Pitt-Greensburg won fourteen matches, more than any other program in the conference.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Pitt-Greensburg midfielder Bella Carroto has scored fifteen goals and added two assists on 50 shots.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Pitt-Greensburg defender Dionna Santia has recorded twelve assists while taking only seven shots.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Hilbert goalkeeper Keira McFarland has made 153 saves and allowed 38 goals, posting a 0.801 save percentage.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Mount Aloysius has conceded 70 goals while scoring eight, allowing more goals than any other program in the conference.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Penn State Behrend has drawn goals from at least ten different scorers across its matches.

last_match.line: The defeat ended Pitt-Greensburg's winning run after victories over Franciscan and McDaniel.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
